title: Data on Amounts and Sources of Wealth Inflows into Singapore
what_it_is: Data on Amounts and Sources of Wealth Inflows into Singapore

sections.label: Wealth inflows into Singapore
sections.summary: Asked the Prime Minister for the value of wealth inflows into Singapore over the past five years, in aggregate and by top 10 source countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister in each of the past five years to date, what is the value of wealth inflows into Singapore (i) on aggregate and (ii) as broken down by the top 10 source countries.

sections.label: Foreign non-retail client AUM
sections.summary: AUM of foreign non-retail individual clients managed by financial institutions in Singapore rose about S$470 billion from 2017 to 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Based on the survey, the Assets Under Management (AUM) of foreign non-retail individual clients managed by financial institutions in Singapore increased by about S$470 billion from 2017 to 2021.

sections.label: Family office assets under management
sections.summary: MAS' annual survey has no family office breakdown; tax-incentivised Singapore family offices managed about S$90 billion as at 2021, under 2% of S$5.4 trillion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: There is no breakdown for family offices in particular in MAS’ annual survey, which I cited.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: However, Singapore family offices (SFOs) that apply for and are granted tax incentives by MAS managed about S$90 billion of assets as at 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: This is less than 2% of the S$5.4 trillion assets managed in Singapore as at 2021.

sections.label: MAS market operations and capital flows
sections.summary: MAS addresses such pressures in regular market operations; no unusual Singapore dollar capital surges required a pronounced response, and family offices are not a significant portion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: MAS addresses any such pressures, regardless of the source of funds, as part of its regular market operations to achieve its monetary policy objectives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: We have not seen unusual surges of capital into the Singapore dollar that have required a pronounced response on MAS’ part, and certainly not from family offices which, to reiterate, would not form a significant portion of the total flow of funds for management out of Singapore.

sections.label: Core inflation cost increases
sections.summary: Higher global energy, imported food prices and domestic wage growth drove the step-up in core inflation since late-2021, accounting for nearly 75% of MAS' Core Inflation in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The step-up in core inflation since late-2021 was primarily due to the sharp increases in global energy, imported food prices and stronger domestic wage growth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: These cost increases fed through to higher electricity and gas, food and essential services prices, accounting for nearly 75% of MAS' Core Inflation in 2022.

sections.label: Family offices and private housing
sections.summary: Family offices have had virtually no impact on the private housing market, with no residential property transaction attributable to them over the last six years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: More specific to Mr Leong’s question, family offices themselves have had virtually no impact on our private housing market as there was no residential property transaction attributable to family offices over the last six years.

sections.label: Source country breakdown
sections.summary: The speaker says the source region is Asia Pacific, followed by Europe and Americas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I think I will talk about the first supplementary question which is effectively on source country breakdown.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: I had mentioned earlier on that, in fact, the source region is the Asia Pacific region, followed by Europe and Americas.

sections.label: Foreigners' private housing share
sections.summary: Foreigners' share of private housing purchase fell from about 20% in 2011 to about 7% in the first quarter of 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The foreigners' share of private housing purchase has dropped from about 20% in 2011 to about a low of about 3% to 4% over the past few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Coming out of the pandemic, the share has remained limited – about 7% in the first quarter of 2023.
